17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 1000 North Francisco Avenue, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: |§ RM-5 Residential Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 3,187.3 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to redevelop the subject property with a new
three-story residential building containing six (6) dwelling units. The
proposed building will measure 37 ft.-9 inches in height. The subject
property is a Transit Served Location and will be supported by three (3) off-
street parking spaces at the rear. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional
Administrative Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Secs. 17-13-1101
of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking optional
Variation approval to reduce the front setback to 4 ft., reduce the rear
setback to 18 ft., reduce the combined side setback to 4 ft.-10 inches, and
any other relief necessary, as allowed by the Code, for the Type 1 Plan Set.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 5,287.09 square feet (1.66 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 531.13 square feet per D.U.
(6 residential units)

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 3 parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location (Division Street Bus
Route).

(@) = Setbacks:
a. *Front Setback: 4 ft. (proposed)
b. Side Setbacks:
South Side: 3 ft. (proposed)
North Side: 1 ft.-10 inches (proposed)
c. *Rear Setback: 18 ft. (proposed)

*Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1101-B, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the front
setback to 6ft. and reduce the rear setback to 18 ft.

(E) Building Height: 37 ft.-9 inches
